source.title: Queensland Government — Common sensitive plant
source.excerpt: Spread mainly by seeds clinging to humans and animals.

used_path_nearby.yes: Check vegetated edges of the recorded nearby path.
used_path_nearby.no: Inspect vegetation around the reported plant.
used_path_nearby.unknown: Inspect vegetation around the reported plant, including vegetated edges of any nearby paths.

Mimosa pudica.limitation: People and animals can transport seeds; their actual routes are not known.

source.title: Queensland Government — Leucaena
source.excerpt: Each pod contains about 20 flat, glossy brown seeds that scatter when ripe.

ripe_pods_visible.yes: Inspect the ground around the tree for seedlings where ripe or opened pods are recorded.
ripe_pods_visible.no: Inspect around the reported tree for additional plants; ripe pods were not observed.
ripe_pods_visible.unknown: Check for ripe or opened pods and inspect the ground around the tree for seedlings.

Leucaena leucocephala.limitation: This does not establish a dispersal distance.

source.title: Queensland Government — Yellow guava, page 2
source.excerpt: Cut stems will re-shoot, and guavas can sucker from their roots.

previous_cutting.yes: Inspect the treated location for reshooting stems and root suckers.
previous_cutting.no: Inspect around the reported plant for additional plants; previous cutting was not recorded.
previous_cutting.unknown: Check for signs of previous cutting. Where cut stems or stumps are present, inspect for reshooting stems and root suckers.

Psidium guajava.limitation: This supports a local regrowth check, not distant block selection.

source.title: RiceIPM — Commelina diffusa, Biology and ecology
source.excerpt: Cut stems can rapidly develop into new plants with roots developing from nodes.

previous_cutting.yes: Inspect the affected vegetation patch for remaining stem pieces and rooted nodes.
previous_cutting.no: Inspect the surrounding creeping stems for rooted nodes.
previous_cutting.unknown: Inspect surrounding creeping stems for rooted nodes. Where cutting has occurred, check for remaining stem pieces.

Commelina diffusa.limitation: The map does not establish the vegetation patch or soil moisture.

source.title: Florida Department of Agriculture — Means of Dispersal
source.excerpt: Dense colonies form through the growth and fragmentation of rhizomes.

actions.always: Inspect vegetation around the visible patch for additional shoots.

Imperata cylindrica.limitation: The underground extent and connections cannot be established from the map.

source.title: Revista Arvore (2008) — Reproductive ecology, birds and bats
source.excerpt: both vertebrate groups can efficiently disperse M. calabura seeds in urban reforestation areas

actions.always: Look for additional seedlings in surrounding vegetation.

Muntingia calabura.limitation: General inspection prompt only. Local bird and bat movements are unknown.

actions.always: Check surrounding ground for additional plants of the confirmed species.

Cleome rutidosperma.limitation: General inspection prompt only. No ant route, search radius or water pathway is established.
